name: Printbar
author: mryll
description: Printer status, supplies, trays and jobs (printbar) in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Click: status panel. Right click: printer web panel (EWS). Middle click: refresh.

schema.label: Config file override
schema.description: Optional. Passed to printbar as PRINTBAR_CONFIG; empty uses ~/.config/printbar/config.toml.

schema.label: Hide when idle
schema.description: Show the widget only while printing or when the printer needs attention.

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: full: colored everywhere. none: monochrome everywhere. bar-only: colored bar glyph, monochrome panel. panel-only: colored panel, monochrome bar glyph. Severity still reads through text, glyphs and the meter outline.
